info.name: GIU Nexus API - Milestone 2
info.description:
Complete API collection for GIU Nexus - AI-Powered Career & Talent Platform (Milestone 2).

SETUP:
1. BASE_URL is pre-set to http://localhost:5000/api/v1
2. Run Login -> TOKEN auto-sets via test script
3. Admin accounts must be created directly in the DB (no /register for admin)
4. JOB_ID auto-sets after Create Job; APP_ID auto-sets after Apply to Job

MILESTONE 2 REQUIRED TEST SCENARIOS:
a) Full auth flow: Register as jobSeeker -> Login -> Use protected route
b) Recruiter approval: Register recruiter (pending) -> Admin approves -> Recruiter posts job
c) AI category: Create job -> Check auto-assigned category in response
d) Skill extraction: Update bio -> POST /profile/extract-skills -> Skills saved to profile
e) Job recommendations: GET /jobs/recommended -> Ranked list with score values
f) Full application flow: Apply -> Recruiter shortlists -> GET /applications/my shows updated status
g) Business rules: Duplicate apply -> 400 | Pending recruiter posts job -> 403

Endpoints marked [ADDITIONAL] are implemented but outside the Milestone 2 spec.
Endpoints marked [BONUS] are from the Milestone 2 Bonus Features section.

item.name: Auth
item.description:
Authentication endpoints: register, login, logout, password reset with OTP, and MFA.

All rate-limited: 10 requests per 15 minutes per IP (express-rate-limit).

Milestone: register, login, logout, forgot-password, reset-password
Bonus: verify-otp (OTP-based MFA), token blacklist logout
Additional: verify-mfa, setup-totp
